visual_aesthetic.description: A high-end insurtech platform that blends the trustworthiness of a premium financial institution with the warmth and approachability of a lifestyle brand. Avoids cold 'tech-bro' aesthetics. Uses generous whitespace, soft drop shadows, warm gold accents, and organic rounded corners to make the stressful process of insurance feel safe and easy.

spacing_and_layout.scale_philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-6, p-8, p-12. White space creates luxury.

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors

cards.base: bg-white border border-gray-100 shadow rounded-2xl p-6
cards.interactive: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer border border-transparent hover:border-primary/20

inputs.base: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all
inputs.label: block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1

component_patterns.navigation: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-gray-100 sticky top-0 z-50
component_patterns.animation: framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions. duration-300 ease-out

landing_page.header: Sticky nav, Logo left, Links center (Products, Claims, Support), Primary CTA right (Get Quote).
landing_page.hero: Split layout: Left text-heavy with H1 ('Premium Protection for Your Peace of Mind'), caption, CTA 'Explore Plans'. Right side: Dynamic curved image masking of the family lifestyle image.
landing_page.product_tiles: Bento grid of 4 cards (Travel, Health, Motor, Device). Each card has an icon, title, description, and an arrow link.
landing_page.stats_testimonials: Full width soft gray background. 3 large stat counters. Testimonial carousel featuring real user quotes.
landing_page.footer: Dark slate background, white/gold text. Sitemap, legal links, newsletter signup.

auth.layout: Split screen: Left side clean white with login/signup form (Email + Phone OTP mocked). Right side full-height lifestyle image (Travel/Health) with gold overlay gradient.

customer_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Overview, Policies, Claims, Profile) + Main content area. Background #F8F9FA.
customer_dashboard.overview: Top: Welcome back user. AI Recommendations banner (e.g., 'Upcoming trip? Add travel coverage'). Middle: 'My Active Policies' horizontal cards. Bottom: 'Recent Activity' timeline.
customer_dashboard.policies_list: Table or List view. Clicking a row opens a slide-out drawer (Sheet component) showing details, coverage limits, and 'Download PDF' button.
customer_dashboard.claims_wizard: Multi-step form (Progress bar at top). Steps: 1. Select Policy, 2. Incident Details, 3. Upload Documents (Drag & Drop zone), 4. Review & Submit.
customer_dashboard.claims_tracker: Vertical step progress component showing states: Filed -> Review -> Approved -> Paid.
customer_dashboard.ai_chat: Floating action button opening a side-panel. Claude-powered assistant for policy questions.

quote_flow.layout: Centered narrow container (max-w-2xl) to reduce cognitive load.
quote_flow.steps: Destination autocomplete -> Dates (Shadcn Calendar) -> Travelers counter -> Coverage tier slider (Basic/Premium/VIP) -> Price breakdown.
quote_flow.checkout: Summary card on left, Stripe payment elements on right. Gold 'Pay Securely' button.

admin_crm.layout: Dense dashboard (Control Room Grid). Sidebar collapsed by default.
admin_crm.customer_360: Profile header (Name, KYC status, Risk Score). Bento grid: Active Policies, Claim History, LTV, Interaction Timeline, AI Next-best-action.
admin_crm.leads_kanban: Horizontal scrolling columns: New -> Contacted -> Quoted -> Won -> Lost. Draggable cards.
admin_crm.analytics: Top KPIs: MRR, Active Policies, Claim Ratio. Charts: Revenue over time (Recharts Area), Policy Mix (Recharts Donut).
admin_crm.claims_queue: Dense data table with filters (Status, Type, Date). Quick action buttons: Approve (Green), Reject (Red).

hero_lifestyle.usage: Landing page hero section, Auth right panel

data_testid_conventions.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, and Framer Motion.
Import 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' fonts via Google Fonts and set them in tailwind.config.js.
Configure all primary and secondary colors in tailwind.config.js as defined in this JSON.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the landing page layout to ensure creative freedom, leveraging the provided image URLs.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively for the CRM Dashboard, Quote Flow, and Claims Wizard (Forms, Inputs, Select, Tables, Cards, Dialogs, Sheets).
Always apply data-testid attributes to interactive elements.
Ensure hover states are explicitly defined for text and background colors.
Do not use generic placeholder image URLs; use the media URLs provided in this document.
When building charts for the Admin CRM, utilize Recharts.
